summary:
Suezmaxes
Moving Out of West Africa Something is happening to Suezmax tankers on one of their most important trades. The following chart shows that while the combined total of Suezmax and Vlcc spot fixtures is a little ahead of where they were five years ago (2004 data has been annualized), the number of Suezmax spot fixtures is declining. # Suezmax & Vlcc Fixtures ex-West Africa
Vlcc fixtures have climbed from 220 in 1999 to an anticipated 320 in 2004 while Suezmax spot fixtures have declined from 620 in 1999 to an anticipated 540 in 2004.
